* Transient Requirement tr_reg: Output voltage regulation at 5V target; verify ripple reduction from SW2 synchronous rectification
tran 2e-07 0.01 0 5e-07
linearize
meas tran Vout_avg avg v(n5) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Vout_avg
meas tran Vout_ripple_vpp pp v(n5) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Vout_ripple_vpp
meas tran Vin_avg avg v(n0) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Vin_avg
meas tran Iout_avg avg i(vr_load_sense) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Iout_avg
let VIN_MEAS = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_VIN_MEAS.csv v(n0)
let VOUT = v(n5)
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_VOUT.csv v(n5)
let PWM1_gate_diff = v(n1) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM1.csv PWM1_gate_diff
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM2.csv v(n3)
let v_SW1_auto = v(n0) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_SW1.csv v_SW1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_SW1.csv i(VSW1_SENSE)
let v_SW1_gate_auto = v(n1) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW1.csv v_SW1_gate_auto
let v_SW2_auto = v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_SW2.csv v_SW2_auto
wrdata time_series/I_SW2.csv i(VSW2_SENSE)
let v_SW2_gate_auto = v(n3)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW2.csv v_SW2_gate_auto
let v_L1_auto = v(n2) - v(n5)
wrdata time_series/V_L1.csv v_L1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_L1.csv i(VL1_SENSE)
let v_Cout_auto = v(n5)
wrdata time_series/V_Cout.csv v_Cout_auto
wrdata time_series/I_Cout.csv i(VCout_SENSE)
let v_R_LOAD_auto = v(n5)
wrdata time_series/V_R_LOAD.csv v_R_LOAD_auto
wrdata time_series/I_R_LOAD.csv i(VR_LOAD_SENSE)
plot v(n0) title 'tr_reg_VIN_MEAS'
plot v(n5) title 'tr_reg_VOUT'
plot PWM1_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM1'
plot v(n3) title 'Gate_PWM2'
plot v_SW1_auto title 'V_SW1'
plot i(VSW1_SENSE) title 'I_SW1'
plot v_SW1_gate_auto title 'Gate_SW1'
plot v_SW2_auto title 'V_SW2'
plot i(VSW2_SENSE) title 'I_SW2'
plot v_SW2_gate_auto title 'Gate_SW2'
plot v_L1_auto title 'V_L1'
plot i(VL1_SENSE) title 'I_L1'
plot v_Cout_auto title 'V_Cout'
plot i(VCout_SENSE) title 'I_Cout'
plot v_R_LOAD_auto title 'V_R_LOAD'
plot i(VR_LOAD_SENSE) title 'I_R_LOAD'

* Transient Requirement tr_eff: Efficiency analysis; compare synchronous rectifier conduction loss to equivalent diode Vf drop
tran 2e-07 0.01 0 5e-07
linearize
meas tran Iin_avg avg i(vin) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Iin_avg
meas tran Iout_avg avg i(vr_load_sense) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Iout_avg
meas tran Vout_avg avg v(n5) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Vout_avg
meas tran Vin_avg avg v(n0) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Vin_avg
meas tran Isw1_rms rms i(vsw1_sense) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Isw1_rms
meas tran Isw2_rms rms i(vsw2_sense) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Isw2_rms
meas tran IL1_rms rms i(vl1_sense) from=0.008 to=0.01
print IL1_rms
meas tran Icout_rms rms i(vcout_sense) from=0.008 to=0.01
print Icout_rms
wrdata time_series/tr_eff_ISW1.csv i(vsw1_sense)
wrdata time_series/tr_eff_ISW2.csv i(vsw2_sense)
let VIN_EFF = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/tr_eff_VIN_EFF.csv v(n0)
let PWM1_gate_diff = v(n1) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM1.csv PWM1_gate_diff
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM2.csv v(n3)
plot i(vsw1_sense) title 'tr_eff_ISW1'
plot i(vsw2_sense) title 'tr_eff_ISW2'
plot v(n0) title 'tr_eff_VIN_EFF'
plot PWM1_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM1'
plot v(n3) title 'Gate_PWM2'
